query: INSERT INTO orders SELECT __time, country, channel, SUM(revenue) AS revenue_sum, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM TABLE(EXTERN('s3://orders-warehouse/year=2024/', '{"type":"parquet"}', '[{"name":"__time","type":"long"},{"name":"country","type":"string"},{"name":"channel","type":"string"},{"name":"revenue","type":"double"}]')) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 PARTITIONED BY DAY
